task_title: Average net margin and sector ranking

criteria.text: Reports the average net margin across the companies as approximately 14.0%.
States that IT Services has the highest average net margin (approximately 21.3%).
States that Automobile has the lowest average net margin (approximately 9.0%).
Computes the average margin as total profit divided by total revenue (about 13.3%) and labels it the average net margin.
Names a sector other than IT Services as the highest-margin sector.
